sub_graphs.title: EIP-7939: CLZ Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions during CLZ (Count Leading Zeros) opcode execution in the EVM

nodes.label: Stack Value Ready for CLZ
nodes.description: EVM state where a 256-bit value is on top of the stack awaiting CLZ operation

nodes.label: Pop Stack Value
nodes.description: Pop the top 256-bit unsigned integer from the EVM stack

nodes.label: Value Popped from Stack
nodes.description: The 256-bit input value has been retrieved from the stack for processing

nodes.label: Count Leading Zero Bits
nodes.description: Count consecutive zero bits preceding the most significant one bit in the 256-bit value

nodes.label: CLZ Result Computed
nodes.description: The count of leading zeros has been determined (range 0-256)

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push the CLZ result (0-256) onto the EVM stack

nodes.label: CLZ Result on Stack
nodes.description: The leading zero count is now on top of the EVM stack

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7939: CLZ Gas Consumption
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas accounting for the CLZ opcode execution

nodes.label: Gas Available for Execution
nodes.description: EVM has sufficient gas remaining to attempt CLZ execution

nodes.label: Check Gas Availability
nodes.description: Verify at least 5 gas units are available for CLZ opcode

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient for CLZ
nodes.description: At least 5 gas units available, execution can proceed

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Less than 5 gas units available, execution will fail

nodes.label: Deduct 5 Gas Units
nodes.description: Subtract 5 gas from remaining gas counter (matches MUL pricing to avoid DoS)

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7939: CLZ Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation and special case handling for CLZ opcode inputs

nodes.label: Input Value Received
nodes.description: A 256-bit unsigned integer has been popped for CLZ processing

nodes.label: Check if Input is Zero
nodes.description: Determine if the input value equals zero (special case)

nodes.label: Input is Zero
nodes.description: Special case: input value is exactly zero

nodes.label: Input is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Standard case: input has at least one bit set

nodes.label: Return 256
nodes.description: For zero input, return 256 (all bits are leading zeros)

nodes.label: Compute Standard CLZ
nodes.description: Count leading zeros before most significant one bit (result 0-255)

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'Pops 1 value from the stack' without explicit handling of stack underflow conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM stack underflow behavior applies: if stack is empty, execution reverts with stack underflow error. This follows existing EVM semantics.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior if this opcode is executed before the fork activation block.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume pre-activation execution treats 0x1e as an invalid opcode, causing execution to halt. This is standard fork activation behavior.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas cost of 5 is assumed to be sufficient to prevent denial-of-service attacks under all execution environments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If CLZ computation on certain hardware is significantly slower than MUL, attackers could create blocks that take disproportionately long to execute, causing DoS.

implicit_assumptions.description: All EVM implementations will implement CLZ with constant-time execution regardless of input value.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Variable execution time could lead to timing side-channel attacks in contract execution.

implicit_assumptions.description: The opcode 0x1e is currently unassigned and its use will not conflict with any other proposed or existing functionality.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Opcode collision could cause undefined behavior in contracts designed for different fork versions.
